decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 3 Chesterfield Road Chiswick W.4.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00 a.m.   to 6.00 p.m.  on Mondays to Friday and  9.00 a.m.  to 12.30 p.m. on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the west elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any flank wall of the extensions   hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 9 - The development shall not be occupied until the existing access to Chesterfield Road  is closed and reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement. The reinstatement works shall include the reinstatement of the grass verge.

Condition : 10 - The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on drawing No.0301 (DL) 004 Revision E shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.
description: Erection of two storey side extension, single storey rear extension, roof extension, alterations and parking space to dwellinghouse.
